mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate which may have additive CNS depressant effects, and both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for enzyme competition; flecainide has narrow therapeutic index and carisoprodol may increase CNS depression risk in patients with cardiac conditions.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression and dizziness; use caution in patients with cardiac arrhythmias; consider alternative muscle relaxant with lower CNS effects if flecainide therapy is critical.
